response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) AS ast_alt_avg, AVG(APTT - PT) AS aptt_pt_avg FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(ast_alt_avg) AS avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(aptt_pt_avg) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_status

assumptions.assumption: The WBC cutoff selects records with WBC > 6.5; the request does not specify which side of the cutoff to use.

alternatives.interpretation: Select records with WBC at or below 6.5 instead.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) AS ast_alt_avg, AVG(APTT - PT) AS aptt_pt_avg FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC <= 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(ast_alt_avg) AS avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(aptt_pt_avg) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_status
